column1: # Historical reference comparisons: frozen fixtures, sealed experiments and stored ledgers compared with the current engine.
# They are NOT current-product tests and are not reported as passing. conftest.py marks exactly these ids `historical_reference`;
# the current-product suite runs `-m "not historical_reference"` and must have 0 failures. A separate CI step runs
# `-m historical_reference` and requires exactly these differences (no new difference, no silent disappearance).
# Expected values, ledger amounts and sealed SHAs are NOT edited. CD-15 is additionally reproduced with its sealed engine files.

column3: LEGACY_FIXTURE_VS_CURRENT (CL42 fixture recorded on the legacy selector at visit-state-v2.2; the current legacy selector reports +external-delivery-v1 and its paid amounts differ; legacy is a developer comparison engine, not the product path)
RESEARCH_REFERENCE_VS_CURRENT_CATALOG (A08 action sequence still matches; transaction rows differ after the official menu/price catalog split products, e.g. Sky Yard price-tier label)
SEALED_ENGINE_EXPERIMENT (CD-15 refuses to compute on the current engine by design; reproduced with the sealed engine files by check_historical_contracts.py)
SEALED_ENGINE_EXPERIMENT (same CD-15 seal; reproduced by check_historical_contracts.py)
STORED_LEGACY_LEDGER_VS_CURRENT (stored 11-person legacy day vs same-condition recomputation; explained by explain_ledger_gaps.py)
